statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharP F p] (f : LR.R p →+* F), (∀ (q : LR.R p) (a d : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d → (q : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / d → f q = (a : F) / (d : F)) ∧ RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {(p : LR.R p)}
proof:
intro F _ _ f
have formula (q : LR.R p) (a d : ℤ) (hd : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d) (hq : (q : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / d) : f q = (a : F) / (d : F) := by
  have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 from fun h => hd (h ▸ dvd_zero _))
  have he : q * (d : LR.R p) = (a : LR.R p) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (q : ℚ) * (d : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
    rw [hq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd0]
  have hf : f q * (d : F) = (a : F) := by simpa using congrArg f he
  exact (eq_div_iff ((CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff F p d).not.mpr hd)).2 hf
refine ⟨formula, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
· intro q hq
  obtain ⟨a, d, hd, he⟩ := (h_T007.2 _).1 q.property
  have hf : (a : F) = 0 := by
    have hz : f q = 0 := hq
    rw [formula q a d hd he, div_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    exact hz.resolve_right ((CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff F p d).not.mpr hd)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff F p a).1 hf
  let t : LR.R p := ⟨(z : ℚ) / d, (h_T007.2 _).2 ⟨z, d, hd, rfl⟩⟩
  apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (q : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * ((z : ℚ) / d)
  rw [he, hz]
  push_cast
  ring
· apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro q hq
  obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hq
  change f (p : LR.R p) = 0
  simp [CharP.cast_eq_zero F p]

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [fieldK : Field K] (l : ℕ) (V : Type) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    (FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧
        Module.finrank ℂ V = l + 1 ∧
          h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧
            h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧
              x * y - y * x = h ∧ ∀ (W : Submodule ℂ V), LR.inv W x → LR.inv W y → LR.inv W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) →
      ((∃ ι b c, ∀ (i : ι), ↑(b i) = c i) ∧
          ∀ (r : ℕ), (∀ (m : ↥M), (LR.divided x r) ↑m ∈ M) ∧ ∀ (m : ↥M), (LR.divided y r) ↑m ∈ M) →
        (LR.N2 p l M x y v ∧ ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ LR.localRing p ↔ ∃ a d, ¬↑p ∣ d ∧ q = ↑a / ↑d) →
          ∀ (F : Type) [inst : Field F] [CharP F p] (f : LR.R p →+* F),
            (∀ (q : LR.R p) (a d : ℤ), ¬↑p ∣ d → ↑q = ↑a / ↑d → f q = ↑a / ↑d) ∧ RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {↑p}
